title: Shared radio listening schedule
summary: A low-power listening schedule for radio or official broadcast updates so batteries are preserved and households hear consistent information.
content: Core sequence: 1) Choose two or three listening windows and turn the radio fully off between them. 2) Write station, time, message, source confidence, and action required. 3) Share only the written summary, not memory or emotional interpretation. 4) Update evacuation, water, road, school, and power notes after each listening window.
